title: The Minimum Wage as an Anchor: Effects on Determinations of Fairness by Humans and AI
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures the anchoring effect of minimum wage on the perception of a fair wage by humans and AI, and also tests for biases related to gender and race.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
